Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.admin

Class ApiKeysAdminController

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.admin.ApiKeysAdminController
@RestController @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public class ApiKeysAdminController extends Object
REST adapter for the admin API-key endpoints (REQ-AUTH-007 / REQ-AUTH-012, design §6.2.3).

Class-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") is defense in depth on top of the URL-level rule /api/v1/admin/** → hasRole('ADMIN') introduced in US-04-009. Both layers reject STANDARD JWTs and SYSTEM API-key callers with 403.

No class-level @RequestMapping: the /api/v1 prefix is applied centrally by WebConfig (REQ-API-006).
